nodes.label: NO_COLOR=1 Monochrome Mode
nodes.rationale: Setting NO_COLOR=1 forces pure black-and-white mode, honoring the accessibility/terminal-capability convention.

nodes.label: SpotUI
nodes.rationale: No local library: streams from YouTube on demand via mpv/yt-dlp; audio-only playback and small footprint (~20 MiB TUI + ~5-40 MiB mpv) keep RAM low.

nodes.label: Audio-Only Playback (no video)
nodes.rationale: Audio-only (no video): mpv plays the bestaudio stream resolved by yt-dlp, which keeps the RAM footprint low (~5-40 MiB alongside the ~20 MiB TUI).

nodes.label: True-Color Terminal Rendering (Spotify green #1DB954, gradient covers)
nodes.norm_label: true-color terminal rendering (spotify green #1db954, gradient covers)
nodes.rationale: Terminals that support palette changes (kitty, alacritty, gnome-terminal run directly) render the exact Spotify green #1DB954 and playlist covers as true-color gradients (16.7M colors); tmux and non-supporting terminals fall back to 256 colors which still looks decent - a graceful-degradation trade-off between visual fidelity and ubiquity.
